sections.title: What You Are Learning
paragraphs: AWS networking answers a familiar question: How does everything communicate? The exam asks how AWS resources should be networked, secured, named, and connected to external networks.
bullets: VPC components such as subnets and gateways
VPC security with network ACLs, security groups, and Amazon Inspector
sections.callout: How should AWS resources be networked, secured, named, and connected to external networks?

sections.title: Maestro Mental Model
sections.callout: NETWORK · SEGMENT · PATH · PROTECT · RESOLVE · CONNECT

sections.title: Amazon VPC
paragraphs: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) provides a logically isolated virtual network in AWS. Inside a VPC, customers can organize and control networking for AWS resources. The concept should feel familiar to anyone who knows traditional networking.
sections.callout: Isolated virtual network in AWS → Amazon VPC

sections.title: Subnets
paragraphs: A subnet divides a VPC network into smaller network segments. Like subnetting in traditional networking, subnets help organize resources and network placement.

sections.title: Public and Private Network Placement
paragraphs: Resources can be placed into different subnet designs depending on whether they need direct internet-facing connectivity. A common architecture places public-facing resources in an internet-accessible network segment and backend resources in private network segments.
sections.callout: Not everything should be directly exposed.

sections.title: Gateways
paragraphs: Gateways provide connectivity between networks. Depending on the design, a gateway can connect a VPC to another destination.
sections.callout: Need a path between the VPC and another network → Gateway

sections.title: Security Groups
paragraphs: A security group controls allowed traffic for associated AWS resources. Security groups are stateful, so return traffic associated with an allowed connection is automatically permitted.

sections.title: Network ACLs
paragraphs: A network access control list (network ACL or NACL) provides traffic filtering at the subnet level. Network ACLs are stateless and can contain both allow and deny rules.

sections.title: Big Exam Trap — Security Group vs. Network ACL

entries.title: Security Group
paragraphs: Resource level and stateful. Think of a guard standing at the individual building.

entries.title: Network ACL
paragraphs: Subnet level and stateless. Think of a checkpoint at the neighborhood entrance.

sections.callout: RESOURCE + STATEFUL = SECURITY GROUP · SUBNET + STATELESS = NACL

sections.title: Amazon Inspector
paragraphs: For networking and security recognition, Amazon Inspector helps identify software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure in supported workloads. Do not confuse it with a firewall: Inspector identifies issues, while security groups and NACLs control network traffic.
sections.callout: What is exposed or vulnerable? → Amazon Inspector

sections.title: Exam Trap — Inspector vs. Security Group

table.caption: Identify issues or control traffic
rows: Identify a vulnerability or unintended exposure

sections.title: Amazon Route 53
paragraphs: Amazon Route 53 is AWS's highly available and scalable Domain Name System (DNS) service. DNS translates human-readable domain names into information systems can use to locate resources.

entries.title: DNS Scenario
paragraphs: A company wants DNS services for its domain.

sections.callout: DNS and name resolution → Amazon Route 53

sections.title: Exam Trap — Route 53 Is DNS
paragraphs: Do not let the word Route make you treat Route 53 as AWS's generic router. For Cloud Practitioner recognition, Route 53 means DNS.

sections.title: Connecting to AWS
paragraphs: Organizations often need to connect their existing networks to AWS. The two major options in this objective are AWS VPN and AWS Direct Connect.

sections.title: AWS VPN
paragraphs: AWS VPN provides encrypted connectivity between networks or clients and AWS across network connections such as the internet.

entries.title: VPN Scenario
paragraphs: A company needs secure encrypted connectivity between its existing network and AWS.

sections.title: AWS Direct Connect
paragraphs: AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network connection between an organization's environment and AWS. It does not rely on the public internet in the same way an internet-based VPN connection does.
sections.callout: Dedicated connection to AWS → AWS Direct Connect

sections.title: Big Exam Trap — VPN vs. Direct Connect

entries.title: AWS VPN
paragraphs: Encrypted connection or tunnel, commonly across internet connectivity.

entries.title: AWS Direct Connect
paragraphs: Dedicated connection to AWS.

sections.callout: TUNNEL = VPN · DEDICATED LINE = DIRECT CONNECT
